Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Kitchen, meals & drinks

whisky noun

also whiskey, spirits

modern

Traupman 406
M-O s.v. whisky

vischium, vischiī n.

noun, second declension

Other words

  • spīritus frūmentī — grain spirit

    also used · modern

    M-O, from 19th-century scientific Latin.

  • aqua vītae — distilled spirits in general

    also used · medieval

    The medieval name for distilled spirits in general; the Gaelic uisce beatha, source of English “whisky”, translates it.

Examples

  • Haec glaciēs vischiō meō servātur.

    This ice is for my whisky.composed

See also ice.

SourcesMorgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. whisky.

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers): p. 406.

The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
